pages.text:
Support your users as though you were in the room. Deacon answers questions, guides them through your product, and tells you what they want to achieve.
DEACON
AI customer support and user insights, live in minutes
Support your users as though you were in the room. Deacon answers their questions, guides them through your product, and tells you what they want to achieve. Activation improves and you have a roadmap to grow your business.
Y O U R C U S T O M E R S
An expert beside your customers, at any hour
Until now, a customer who got stuck sat through a tutorial video or searched help pages written a year ago. Deacon answers them directly, at any hour, in whichever language they write in. It can act on their behalf, suggest a better approach, and point out options they did not know were there.
Y O U R B U S I N E S S
Hear from every customer, not the vocal few
Deacon is in conversation with everyone who uses your product, so what reaches you is the whole picture and not an anecdote. You see the reasoning behind each request, the questions your documentation fails to answer, and the themes worth acting on.
R E V I E W S
What people say
Rated 5 out of 5
Deacon is the future of customer support
It installed quickly, and our users now get support of a quality we could not have provided ourselves. Thank you to the Deacon team.
Makes training and onboarding our users so much easier
Ours is a complex product, and we used to send people to a knowledge center. Nobody wants to read lengthy documentation. Having Deacon answer the question at the moment it comes up has made the difference.
We have seen NPS and revenue move since adding Deacon
Bounce rate dropped and conversions rose after we added it. For a company our size, it paid for itself inside the first month.
The most complete of the modern support agents
We moved across from Intercom and Fin because Deacon does more. It helps our customers, and it tells us what they need, at a lower cost.
O U R S E R V I C E S
KEY FEATURES
AI customer support
The foundation of everything else Deacon does. Your customers ask in plain language and get a considered answer in seconds, drawn from your own material, without waiting in a queue.
User onboarding
Deacon works proactively as well as on request, introducing the features a customer has not found yet and showing them how to use them.
Give it the onboarding material you already have and it will walk each customer through it at their own pace.
User feedback
What your customers are trying to achieve, and where they lose their footing, is the most useful material you have for improving the product.
Deacon speaks to all of them, records the reasoning behind each request, and returns summaries and priorities you can act on.
Knowledge gap analysis
Deacon reads every question against the material you have given it and notices where the two do not meet.
Each gap is raised for your team to close, so the knowledge base improves with every conversation.
Fact-checked answers and validity scoring
Every answer is reviewed and scored against your own knowledge base before it reaches a customer. Where your material does not support a reply, Deacon says so rather than guessing.
Conversation logs and transparency
Every conversation is recorded in full, so you can read exactly what was said on your behalf whenever you need to. Nothing happens out of view.
Knowledge ingestion in minutes
Deacon learns from your documentation, website URLs, and how-to videos. Add a source in the dashboard and its knowledge base updates, and refresh any source the moment your product moves on.
Managed without a developer
A developer is needed once, for the install. After that, curating content, updating knowledge, and reviewing conversations sit comfortably with anyone on your team.
Five minute installation
One line of script in your application, then a handful of URLs and help documents in the dashboard. Deacon is answering the same afternoon.
G E T L I V E
5 minute install
Sign up
Create your account and name your workspace.
Add your content
Paste the URLs of your docs and help pages. Deacon reads them in minutes.
Go live
Copy your one-line snippet and paste it before </body>.
Get started for free
Create an account, add your documentation, and see what your customers have been trying to ask.

If your volume runs past Growth, or your requirements sit outside these three plans, tell us what you need and we’ll work it out with you.
The repeat questions stop reaching you.
Deacon answers from the help pages you’ve already written, so the question you’ve answered a hundred times gets answered without you. What’s left in your inbox is the part that actually needs you.
Nobody hits a dead end.
When Deacon can’t answer, your visitor doesn’t get a shrug. It takes their details and brings you the whole conversation, and you reply from your own inbox, so the thread still ends with a person.
It shows you what your content is missing.
Every question Deacon couldn’t answer is logged as a gap, so you can see exactly which help page you never got round to writing. Write it once and it’s answered from then on.
What counts as an answer?
One AI reply. If Deacon answers, that’s one. Testing in the dashboard and the playground never counts. Follow-up questions in the same conversation are answers too, which is why the allowance on each card also reads as a number of conversations.
Reach your limit and nothing breaks.
Deacon keeps working: it takes the question, captures the visitor, and keeps you in the loop. Everything you’ve already collected stays exactly where it is; only new AI replies pause, and they pick up again when your month rolls over or the moment you upgrade. There’s no overage bill, because there’s no overage.
